summary: Round validates new Ágora features: umbral de alerta (persist/override) + real ingestion (webhook buffer + JSON/CSV file). 21/21 backend tests pass (including 9 new ones). Frontend /agora flow: source toggle, umbral range, plano SVG with threshold line, alertas badge, file input, live buffer refresh — all working end-to-end.

issues: Node labels on plane can overlap when several points share coordinates (e.g. housekeeping/food_beverage/maintenance at the same (x,y) with demo data). Minor cosmetic — consider label offset/collision avoidance.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1980 lines — should be split into modules (dominios, aprendiz, bimestral, ingesta, agora) for maintainability.
agora_conector.parse_archivo silently returns {} on decode/parse failure; server layer converts empty→400 which is fine, but consider surfacing the actual parse error to help clients.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Tests reset hotel umbral to 0.5 and clear gobierno buffer at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ágora endpoints under /api/agora/*: dominios, dominio/{id}, triangular (body: dominio_id, entradas?, umbral?, fuente in {manual,demo,ingesta_live}), umbral/{id} GET+PUT, ingesta/webhook/{id} POST (body {nodo:{obs}}), ingesta/buffer/{id} GET+DELETE, ingesta/archivo POST (multipart dominio_id + files). Umbral persisted in backend/flujo/agora/umbrales.json; buffer per-domain in backend/flujo/agora/ingesta/{dominio}.json. Frontend testids: agora-fuente-{manual|archivo|ingesta_live}, agora-umbral-range/val, agora-plano-svg, agora-alertas, agora-fila-{nodo}, agora-file-input, agora-buffer-refresh.
